title: Senior Security Engineer - AppSec (d/f/m)

title: Senior Director, Clinical Diagnostics and Precision Medicine
description:
Build Our Future Together

Regeneron is seeking an accomplished companion diagnostics (CDx) leader to set strategy and drive execution across a portfolio of therapeutic programs and technologies. As Senior Director, you will ensure that diagnostic strategies are integrated early and aligned with clinical development, regulatory submission, launch readiness, and patient access objectives. You will lead a team of diagnostic professionals and are responsible for overall diagnostic (including CDx) strategies for the entire pipeline of therapeutic areas and across all technologies; partnering across Regeneron and with IVD partners to ensure diagnostic and therapeutic success.

The role requires a leader who can translate biomarker hypotheses into fit-for-purpose diagnostic plans; guide assay selection, validation, and partner strategy; and influence across clinical, translational, regulatory, commercial, medical affairs, access, and external diagnostic organizations.

When & where:

• Location: Remote, USA

• Work model/flexibility: Remote

Discover your role:

• Set and lead global companion diagnostics strategy across the entire pipeline and all technologies, integrating diagnostic plans with clinical strategy, clinical development objectives & timelines, regulatory requirements, launch planning, and patient identification needs.

• Translate biomarker biology, mechanism-of-action hypotheses, clinical utility considerations into diagnostic target product profiles across relevant platforms, including NGS, PCR, immunohistochemistry, immunoassays, and emerging technologies.

• Define assay selection and development strategy from feasibility through analytical and clinical validation, regulatory submission, and post-approval lifecycle planning.

• Lead a team to successfully develop diagnostic strategies that support patient selection (and relevant exploratory datasets), stratification, monitoring, and evidence generation, accounting for timelines, cost, tissue requirements, turnaround time, reimbursement, global regulations and regional implementation.

• Provide executive oversight of external IVD sponsors, laboratory, and technology partner relationships, including partner selection, contracting strategy, governance, budgets, and escalation of critical issues.

• Accountable for operational readiness of CDx testing in clinical trials, including study startup, laboratory workflows, sample management, data transfer, and quality oversight.

• Shape global CDx regulatory strategy in partnership with Regulatory Affairs, including FDA, EU IVDR, PMDA, and other regional requirements, performance study design, submission content, labeling, and health authority interactions.

• Serve as senior CDx subject matter expert and strategic advisor to program teams and leadership, influencing decisions across translational medicine, clinical development, regulatory, biostatistics, clinical operations, commercial, medical affairs, market access, quality, and legal by communicating complex considerations clearly and credibly.

This role requires:

• Advanced degree (PhD, MD, MD/PhD, or equivalent) in molecular biology, pathology, translational medicine, oncology, biomedical engineering, diagnostics, or a related scientific discipline.

• 12 or more years of experience in companion diagnostics, IVD development, biomarker strategy, or translational medicine within pharma, biotech, or diagnostics, including progressive leadership responsibility.

• Demonstrated success leading CDx or biomarker-enabled diagnostic strategies through clinical development, regulatory submission, and therapeutic approval.

• Deep expertise in assay development, analytical and clinical validation, and clinical utility.

• Strong working knowledge of global CDx regulatory pathways, including FDA CDRH (PMA and supplemental submissions), EU IVDR, PMDA, performance studies, labeling, and post-approval obligations.

• Experience managing external diagnostic partners, IVD sponsors

title: Go Senior Software Engineer, AI Training
description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week
Check out this Loom video for more details:
We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.
What this role actually is
You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:
• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.
What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"
We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.
Who you are

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

• Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

• Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well

• Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat

• Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

title: Information Security System Officer (ISSO)
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT EPISCI

EpiSci, an Applied Intuition company, develops next-generation tactical autonomy solutions for national security problems. EpiSci's autonomy software is technology agnostic, operationally informed, and tactically relevant, and has piloted swarms of uncrewed aerial systems and tactical fighter aircraft. Additional applications include crewed-uncrewed teaming for air dominance, cognitive sensors, networks for advanced communications systems, and battle management command and control for informed decision-making. EpiSci delivers speed, cost-efficiency, and scalability as the preferred partner for defense agencies and industry teams seeking mission-critical autonomy solutions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This ISSO owns the day-to-day security posture of EpiSci's classified information systems, collateral and Special Access Program, across our Irvine and Poway facilities.

You will build and maintain authorization packages under the Risk Management Framework, with implementation guidance drawn from JSIG, DAAPM, ICD-503, CMMC, and the NIST 800 series. You will work directly with the ISSM to attain and maintain assessment and authorization from government authorizing officials, from initial requirements through operational deployment and continuous monitoring.

This is a hands-on seat. The work includes configuring, scanning, remediating, and standing up enclaves alongside the documentation. You can expect regular interaction with government security offices and authorizing officials, DCSA, and program security teams, and a continuous review cadence on eMASS and program packages.

Program access: This position requires Special Access Program access. Prior SAP experience is strongly preferred. Candidates with collateral-only experience and a strong track record under RMF will be considered and read on after hire.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Maintain accredited classified systems in an authorized operating state while meeting program delivery timelines

- Author, update, and defend RMF artifacts: System Security Plans (SSP), Security Assessment Reports (SAR), POA&Ms, Risk Assessment Reports, Configuration Management Plans, Incident Response Plans, Continuous Monitoring Plans, and hardware and software baselines

- Execute continuous monitoring: ACAS and Nessus vulnerability scanning, SCAP and STIG compliance checking, audit log review, and remediation tracking against CAT I, II, and III findings

- Support the design, development, and implementation of procedures and systems for secure facilities, and ensure facility compliance with requirements for classified information system processing

description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Akron
Job Location: Work at Home, Ohio, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Part-time employees qualify for:

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a consultative B2B sales role focused on driving platform adoption across UK car dealerships and encouraging active daily auction participation.

You’ll manage a varied portfolio of dealer partners across the UK, ranging from onboarding brand-new businesses and winning back lapsed accounts, to optimizing performance for established, regular buyers. Rather than hard-selling from a rigid script, your goal is to ask great questions, understand each dealership’s unique business goals and position the value of Motorway to demonstrate a clear ROI. You will ultimately build high-value, collaborative and long-term relationships.

Whether you’re delivering a powerful first impression to a new account or embedding repeatable, profitable processes into an existing or lapsed partner's daily routine, you'll act as a trusted advisor to help them win. We don't expect you to know everything on day one, but we do look for solid sales foundations, curiosity, and a drive to learn. We’ll back you with structured coaching, dedicated mentorship, and all the tools you need to succeed.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Consult & Position: Conduct high-level business conversations to uncover dealership needs, positioning Motorway as an essential, long-term inventory solution.

- Drive Network Activity: Onboard new dealership partners, re-engage cold or lapsed accounts, and nurture regular users to drive daily auction participation.

- Demonstrate Value Fast: Clearly articulate ROI to new or hesitant dealers while building repeatable, sustainable buying habits for mature accounts.

- Pipeline Ownership: Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene using HubSpot to log activity, manage your pipeline, and report accurately.

- Overcome Friction: Confidently navigate objections, address dealer pain points, and follow up consistently to keep conversations moving forward.

- Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve dealer challenges and feed market insights back to our product team.

- Hit Targets: Take ownership of your numbers, proactively seeking coaching and feedback whenever you spot room to grow.

WHO YOU ARE

- Sales Foundations: You have background experience in B2B or outbound sales, working comfortably against key performance targets.

- Consultative Mindset: You ask smart questions before pitching, listening intently to tailor your value proposition to each business.

- Adaptable Communicator: Exceptional telephone manner with the confidence to speak to business owners and decision-makers at all levels.

- CRM Competent: Comfortable managing a pipeline and staying organised across a busy, diverse portfolio using HubSpot (or a similar CRM).

- Resilient & Driven: Rejection doesn't derail you; it motivates you to follow up. You’re genuinely energised by hitting and exceeding targets.

- Relationship Builder: You're motivated by true customer success and prefer doing things right over closing a bad deal fast.

- Continuous Learner: You’re coachable and take ownership of your development.

LIFE IN THE TEAM

The B2B Sales team at Motorway is a tight-knit, collaborative group who work hard, celebrate wins together, and genuinely look out for one another. You’ll be encouraged to test new approaches, ask questions, and share ideas.

title: Harness and Platform Engineer, AI Safety and Security Engineering
description:
NVIDIA is widely recognized as one of the most desirable employers, with some of the most talented people in the world working for us! We believe open-weight models are foundational to American AI leadership and cybersecurity, and that trust in AI grows through participation, transparency, and broad scientific scrutiny. Our AI Safety & Security Engineering team builds and evaluates AI-powered tooling that helps find, validate, and patch software vulnerabilities. The agent harness and the platform it runs on are the substrate everything else builds on.
We are looking for a Harness/Platform Engineer to build that foundation. You will play a critical role in making the program's work possible, repeatable, and trustworthy. When a researcher runs an experiment, your platform decides whether the result can be reproduced tomorrow. Our current direction builds on NVIDIA NeMo agent tooling, and you will help shape where it goes. You will keep the whole loop visible, from environment to run to result. You will work closely with security research and evaluation engineers, learning their workflows and smoothing their paths. Good platform work here looks like fewer surprises: environments that behave, tooling that stays versioned, and runs that repeat. When something breaks, you will debug it with the people who felt it first. You will treat researcher time as precious and remove friction wherever you find it.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Harness development:Design, implement, and maintain the agent harness.

• Evaluation infrastructure:Build the systems we use to run and reproduce experiments.

• Reproducibility:Own environments, tooling, and repeatable runs.

• Collaboration:Partner with security and evaluation engineers on their workflows.

What We Need To See:

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years of software engineering experience.

• Technical core:Strong Python engineering plus comfort with containerized environments and CI/CD.

• Infrastructure familiarity:Experience with agent frameworks, LLM orchestration, ML infrastructure, or evaluation harnesses.

• Reproducibility instincts:Care for versioned tooling and repeatable results.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

• NeMo experience:Hands-on work with NVIDIA NeMo or similar agent frameworks.

• Security context:Exposure to security tooling or vulnerability research.

• Developer experience:Building internal tools other engineers enjoy using.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 15, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Electrical Engineer to develop the AI inference compute systems that power OpenAI’s humanoid robots. This role combines compute architecture, high-speed digital design, onboard power electronics, and compact HDI PCB development.

We’re looking for a self-driven engineer who takes ownership from concept through deployment. Above all, you should enjoy hands-on engineering: bringing up boards, characterizing interfaces, and tracking challenging failures to their root cause.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Have 5+ years of experience developing compute hardware or similarly complex high-speed electronics, with demonstrated ownership of complete designs.

- Have strong signal-integrity and power-integrity fundamentals, a solid foundation in power electronics, and practical experience designing complex HDI PCBs.

- Can use a Linux shell, write simple shell scripts, connect over SSH, and perform basic Ethernet and network troubleshooting.

- Take initiative, turn ambiguous requirements into concrete engineering plans, and follow through to deliver working systems.

ADDITIONAL, PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience designing around AI inference SoCs or accelerators, including their power, memory, and communication architectures.

- Familiarity with how AI inference workloads map to silicon capabilities, including compute throughput (TOPS), DRAM bandwidth and capacity, and how workload requirements and DRAM technology choices affect achievable performance and performance per watt.

- Experience bringing compute hardware into production and resolving fabrication, assembly, or test issues with manufacturing partners.

title: SMM switch to Creative Marketing Manager
description:

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

 

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Шукаємо Creative Marketing Manager в команду, де разом піднімаємо планку результатів. Якщо ти зараз працюєш в SMM і хочеш перейти в креативний маркетинг, відгукуйся, такі профілі ми теж розглядаємо.

ЩО РОБИТЬ ЦЮ РОЛЬ ОСОБЛИВОЮ

- Масштаб тестування: гіпотези запускаються системно на широкому міксі каналів.

- Рутина автоматизована: автобриф для постановки задач, шаблони і готова структура для варіацій, AI-стек для текстовок і ресерчу. Свої автоматизації можна викатити на всю команду.

- Команда топових експертів ринку: User Acquisition, дизайн, MarTech та аналітика працюють пліч-о-пліч, і прямі партнерства з Meta і Google.

- Два треки розвитку: поглиблення експертизи до Senior Creative Marketer або перехід у лідерську роль Creative Lead.

ВИКЛИКИ, ЯКІ ЧЕКАЮТЬ НА ЦІЙ РОЛІ

- Досліджувати ринок і конкурентів через спай-тули (Meta Ad Library, Adheart і тп) та формувати на основі цього креативні гіпотези.

- Оформлювати гіпотези у ТЗ для дизайнерів і писати текстовки: хедлайни, дескрипшени, UGC-сценарії.

- Запускати тести разом з User Acquisition менеджерами, аналізувати результати і робити висновки для наступної ітерації.

- Масштабувати креативи, що показали результат, і створювати частину креативів самостійно за допомогою автоматизації і шаблонів.

ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО

- 2+ роки досвіду у перформанс-маркетингу, зокрема повний цикл роботи з дизайнером - від постановки ТЗ і запуску до відповідальності за результат.

- Досвід роботи зі спай-тулами та аналізу конкурентів, інтерес до автоматизації процесів.

- Робота з метриками: вмієш аналізувати результати тестів та аргументувати рішення даними.

- Буде плюсом: базові навички Figma / Adobe, робота з рекламними кабінетами Meta / Google, англійська для написання текстовок.

ЩО ТИ ОТРИМАЄШ ДОДАТКОВО РАЗОМ З НАМИ

- Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: аналітика, продукт, маркетинг, розробка, фінанси і рекрутинг.

- Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій.

- Світлі та сучасні офіси в Києві й Варшаві, а також можливість повністю працювати віддалено.

- Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар.

 

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і фо

title: Smart Contract Engineer
description:
About:

Veda is the DeFi engine powering financial apps enabling platforms to seamlessly create on-chain yield products. Our mission is to unlock DeFi for the world by providing seamless, enterprise-grade integrations for modern finance. Veda 's technology powers many of DeFi's largest vault products, including Liquid, PlasmaUSD Vault, Lombard DeFi Vault, and Mantle cmETH.
At $6B in TVL and 100k+ users, Veda is one of the fastest growing DeFi protocols with a team passionate about DeFi and dedicated to our work. This role will be high impact and have the opportunity to directly shape some of the most critical infrastructure in DeFi.
Role:
As a Smart Contract Engineer, you will contribute to our Solidity engineering organization - architecture, delivery, and security for all on-chain code. You will help to uphold world-class security and reliability standards for contracts securing ten-figure TVL.
We seek individuals with high agency to join us in defining the next phase of DeFi growth and adoption. The ideal candidate takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and adapts swiftly to evolving demands.
Responsibilities:

• Contribute to all Solidity codebases, including upgrade patterns, proxy architecture, account abstraction, and cross-chain messaging.

• Drive rigorous design reviews, threat modeling, fuzz testing, and formal verification to achieve “audit-by-design” security

• Continuous deployment, maintenance, and upgrades of existing vaults

• Own end-to-end delivery of new protocol features

• Manage external auditors and bug-bounty programs; implement on-chain monitoring and incident-response playbooks

• Represent Veda in client integrations, conferences, and the broader open-source community

What you'll bring:

• 6+ years of software engineering experience

• 2-3+ years writing production Solidity (ERC-20/4626, custom libraries, proxy & upgrade patterns)

• Track record of creating or maintaining a contract suite without critical incidents

• Knowledge of EVM internals, gas optimization, storage layout, and common smart-contract exploits (re-entrancy, oracle manipulation, MEV)

• Fluency with Foundry and/or Hardhat,

• Excellent written and verbal English; comfortable presenting to executives, auditors, and the wider community

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Familiarity with multi-chain DeFi interactions and cross-chain messaging standards

• Professional experience using Rust

• Experience using Move-based smart-contract platforms (Aptos) would be a huge plus also.

• Background in traditional finance, risk, credit, or derivatives a plus

• Active contributor to open-source security research, EIPs, or protocol governance

• Formal-verification expertise

• Experience with audit cycles with top-tier firms (e.g., Trail of Bits, Spearbit)

Benefits at Veda

We’re a small, tight-knit team building the infrastructure that powers a new generation of financial products - on-chain, composable, and accessible to anyone. We believe the full potential of DeFi is still ahead of us, and we’re here to help unlock it.
We also believe that great work comes from people who feel trusted, supported, and aligned with the mission. Here’s how we try to make that happen:
Health Coverage
We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees. For international contractors, we work closely to ensure access to appropriate local or global health coverage.
Flexible Time Off
We don’t track vacation days. Take the time you need to rest and recharge-we trust you to manage your schedule.
Remote-First by Design
Our team spans time zones and geographies. We work async, with a focus on autonomy over micromanagement.
Parental Leave
Paid leave is available for new parents, whether you’re the primary or secondary caregiver.
Learning & Development
We offer stipends to support ongoing learning - whether it’s a course, a conference, or something else that helps you grow.

title: Script Writer - Hindi
description:
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

• Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

• Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony)

• Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal )

• Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app)

• Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

• Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal )

• Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

title: Email Coordinator
description:
About This Role

This is a guest-facing email coordination role at a fast-growing luxury travel and concierge company. Day-
to-day, you’ll be the primary link between guests and the hotels and suppliers that make their experiences

exceptional - gathering trip details, communicating guest preferences to hotels, and ensuring every
interaction is warm, accurate, and on-brand. Rate checking is part of the role, but communication is the
core of it. This is not a task-and-log-off role. Full presence, proactive thinking, and genuine ownership are

expected throughout every shift.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Guest & Hotel Email Coordination (Primary)

• Work with guests via email to gather trip information - preferences, special requests, ETAs, and any last-minute

needs.

• Communicate these details to hotels and suppliers ahead of each arrival, ensuring nothing is missed regardless
of whether the client has replied.
• Handle VIP1 & VIP2 pre-arrival touchpoints: confirm arrivals, brief hotels, and follow up with both parties as
needed.
• Maintain a warm, personal, on-brand tone in every message - it should never read like a template.

Rate Checking (Supporting)

• When a booking comes in, verify the guest has the best available rate by checking the hotel’s public website
and/or booking engine - this is confirmation and verification, not proactive deal-hunting.
• Where needed, contact the hotel directly for pricing and information.
• Flag rate discrepancies and document findings accurately - this is investigative, detail-driven work.
• Occasional quoting may be required; when it is, the focus is on retrieving accurate pricing through the right
channels, not finding the cheapest option.

High-Volume Email Management

• Log in, scan the full inbox, triage by urgency, and label before actioning - never work top to bottom.
• Prioritise flagged and time-sensitive items first; process supplier confirmations, replies, and new inquiries
systematically.
• Maintain inbox zero by end of shift - nothing unresolved or unacknowledged.

Hotel & Supplier Outreach

• Email hotels and vendors to confirm bookings, flag special requests, and follow up on outstanding items.
• Where email isn’t getting a response, escalate to a call - but keep most communication via email where

possible.

Shift Handovers & Notion

• Update Notion at the end of every shift with open items, actions taken, and anything the next coordinator needs
to pick up.
• Keep SOPs and task notes current so the team always has visibility.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Genuine passion for travel - you don’t need a CV full of travel jobs, but you need to actually care about this
space and want to grow in it.
• Thinks on their feet - when something goes sideways, you look for a solution before you escalate.
• Warm, polished written communication - professional but personal, never robotic or templated.
• Attention to detail - you catch what others miss, before it reaches the guest.

• Email triage instinct - you scan, sort, and prioritise; you don’t need to be told what matters most.
• Proactive communicator - if you’re stuck, behind, or unsure, you say so early.
• Comfortable with ambiguity - workflows evolve, and you adapt without needing hand-holding.
• Full commitment - exclusivity required. This role cannot be combined with other employment.

SHIFT & AVAILABILITY

Schedule Hard start and end times - not a task-completion role
Hours 9-hour shift including 1-hour unpaid break (8 productive hours)
Start Time Daytime or evening shift TBD - to be confirmed at offer stage
Weekend At least one weekend day required (e.g. Sun-Thu or Tue-Sat)
Exclusivity No concurrent employment - full focus required from day one

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

Email Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets)
Inbox Mgmt Hiver - shared inbox assignments and email tracking
Task / SOPs Notion - team handovers, booking details, client info
AI Drafting Claude - used to support email drafts and workflow efficiency

About the Role
The Senior Incident Response Forensic Analyst is a highly technical member of Digital Forensics and Incident Response (“DFIR”) team. The Senior Forensic Analyst is responsible for conducting forensic investigations of traditional network intrusions in Active Directory environments along with Business Email Compromises (“BEC”). The Senior Analyst assists with technical initiatives that further the business while taking opportunities to mentor junior analysts.
Primary Responsibilities and Duties
Technical Competencies

• Conduct forensic investigations for organizations that have suffered an attack from targeted threats, such as Advanced Persistent Threats, Organized Crime, and politically motivated groups, or from commodity threats such as ransomware groups.

• Perform host forensic analysis on Windows, Linux, and Mac OS based systems.

• Perform network analysis using a variety of tools and log sources to include firewall logs, NetFlow, and logs generated from a variety of network intrusions detection/prevention tools.

• Assist with/conduct the forensic acquisition and analysis from Azure, Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), and Google Cloud Platform (“GCP”) environments.

Leadership and Initiatives

• Stays current with developments within the DFIR field; Integrates new developments into current processes and procedures where necessary

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

title: Warehouse GM
description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town - we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Fulfilled by Faire (FbF) is how brands hand off the hardest part of selling wholesale: picking, packing, shipping, and the cash tied up in inventory. Faire holds brand inventory in our own warehouse network, so a retailer can order from many brands at once and get everything in a single box. It’s a 0-to-1 build that touches nearly every function at Faire. As Warehouse General Manager, you’ll own the performance of the facility behind it, so orders ship on time, arrive undamaged, and inventory is accurate. You’ll oversee the day to day of the building run by our 3PL partner, which employs and supervises the warehouse team.  You’ll hold the operation to clear KPIs, and build the Faire team, systems, and rhythm that let it scale.

What you’ll do 

• Own warehouse performance with our 3PL partner across inbound and outbound SLAs, quality, productivity, and inventory accuracy.

• Manage the relationship between Faire and our logistics partners, keeping leadership informed on pain points and resolving issues quickly when they come up.

• Set the plan for running the facility: labor capacity, cycle count strategy, and the equipment the building needs, etc.

• Own reporting OS that gives a reliable daily/weekly/monthly reporting rhythm that gives Faire's internal leadership clear, actionable visibility into warehouse operations

• Identify and drive improvements in processes, workflows, equipment and/or capacity planning to raise productivity. 

• Build the operational team and capabilities the program needs, including key hires and training programs.

• Partner on warehouse expansion and storage design so the facility can support FbF as it grows beyond today’s footprint.

• Manage vendors like staffing agencies, carriers, equipment vendors, and other third-party partners to contract terms, performance targets, and accountability.

• Partner to improve systems and tools , working closely with Ops, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Support on the systems and tooling to improve operations in the warehouse.

Qualifications

• 12+ years in warehouse, fulfillment, or distribution operations, including 7+ years as a site or general manager of a building of at least 300K sq ft or 500+ associates running multiple shifts. Experience eCommerce, B2B, wholesale, or 3PL fulfillment with high SKU variety, case-pack and each-pick workflows, and brand-owned inventory.

• Experience developing leaders and building a strong warehouse floor culture , including on sites with hundreds of hourly workers. You’re visible on the floor, direct, and calm under peak pressure.

• Experience operating with deep ownership and a bias to action. You move with incomplete information, communicate plainly up and down, and don’t wait for a formal process to get things done.

• Experience managing labor: forecasting, hiring ramps, shift design, and understand the approach for performance management across a mix of employees and agency staff. You build supervisors into leaders and treat people fairly.

• Experience improving efficiency across labor productivity, service levels, and accuracy at scale, with results you can describe in num

In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess - nicht eine Standardpräsentation. Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen. Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung. Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar. Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen. Worauf du dich einstellst Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe

Work closely with SSAs on pipeline visibility and converting well-scoped opportunities into bookings, while the SSA team owns the bookings target.

title: ADA & LOA Specialist | US | Remote
description:
The ADA & LOA Specialist manages the interactive accommodation process and employee leaves of absence for employees and job applicants. The role applies the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), ADAAA, Pregnant Workers Fairness Act (PWFA), Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and applicable state and local leave and accommodation laws.
This role works with employees, people managers, HR business partners, legal counsel, healthcare providers, and third-party leave administrators. The goal is to administer leaves accurately and identify reasonable accommodations that remove workplace barriers while maintaining business operations.
Key responsibilities

•
Interactive process management

• Facilitate the interactive accommodation dialogue from initial request through case resolution.

• Conduct intake interviews with employees to understand functional limitations, job tasks, and specific accommodation needs.

•
Leave of absence administration

• Manage a caseload of FMLA, state leave, short- and long-term disability, military, and personal leaves from request through return-to-work.

• Determine eligibility and issue eligibility, rights and responsibilities, and designation notices within required timelines.

• Track intermittent leave usage and reconcile it against attendance and timekeeping records.

• Coordinate with third-party leave administrators, payroll, and benefits so pay and benefits continue correctly during leave.

• Manage return-to-work, including fitness-for-duty documentation and the transition to accommodation when restrictions remain or leave is exhausted.

•
Medical review and analysis

• Review and evaluate medical documentation from healthcare providers to verify coverage under ADA guidelines and assess functional restrictions.

• Review leave medical certifications for completeness and follow up on missing or unclear information.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of employee health information in compliance with ADA, FMLA, and HIPAA standards, keeping medical files separate from personnel files.

•
Cross-functional collaboration

• Partner with department leaders and HR to assess essential job functions and evaluate accommodation feasibility (e.g., adaptive equipment, flexible scheduling, remote work, duty modifications).

• Advise managers on appropriate support techniques, compliance standards, and non-discriminatory practices.

• Advise managers on attendance, job protection, and return-to-work questions tied to leave.

•
Case tracking and compliance

• Maintain accurate, centralized records for accommodation and leave cases, tracking outcomes, temporary accommodations, leave dates, and review dates in the HR case management system.

• Ensure consistent, timely processing of requests in accordance with federal and state statutory timelines.

• Flag compliance risks and escalate complex cases to leadership.

• Prepare regular reports on leave volume, case aging, and accommodation trends.

•
Program support and education

• Help update disability accommodation and leave policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures.

• Assist in delivering training to managers and HR teams on disability inclusion, leave requirements, and interactive process best practices.

•
Experience: 2 to 4 years of experience in HR operations, leave management, or disability services, with direct experience handling ADA accommodation and leave of absence cases.

•
Knowledge: Deep working knowledge of federal and state disability and leave laws (ADA/ADAAA, FMLA, PWFA, and state-specific regulations such as California FEHA and CFRA, and state paid family and medical leave programs).

•
Skills:

• Excellent empathetic communication, intake interviewing, and conflict resolution skills.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex medical notes against job descriptions.

• Ability to manage a high-volume caseload with competing statutory deadlines.

title: Principal Oracle EPM Consultant
description:
Oracle EPM Principal Consultant
Who We Are
R-Cubed Consulting is a business strategy and technology consulting firm powered by relationships, results, and reputation. These core values guide everything we do, shaping our commitment to delivering meaningful value for clients and driving real change in how organizations operate. Our approach centers on collaboration, ensuring both employees and clients are at the heart of our work. From enterprise applications and integration architecture to cloud computing and managed services, we provide solutions that enable confident decision-making and lasting impact. More than just a consulting firm, R-Cubed is a team built on respect, integrity, and collaboration-where every voice matters, contributions drive real impact, and our people feel empowered and supported to succeed.
The Role
We're hiring an Oracle EPM Principal Consultant to lead EPM Cloud Planning work in our Oracle EPM practice, with a focus on the Capital, Workforce and Projects modules. You'll own the client relationship at the executive level and lead implementations from design through go-live. You'll also mentor a growing team of EPM consultants. Clients will count on you to explain how headcount and capital spend flow into their financial plan, and to push back when a requirement doesn't hold up.
Responsibilities

• Lead EPM Cloud Planning implementations focused on Capital, Workforce and Projects, from discovery through go-live and post-launch support.

• Design Workforce Planning models for headcount, compensation, benefits and payroll taxes at the employee or job level.

• Configure Capital Planning for new asset requests, depreciation, transfers and retirements, and tie the results to the balance sheet and cash flow.

• Build Projects Planning for capital, contract and indirect projects. Set up the hand-off from capital projects to assets in Capital Planning.

• Connect Workforce, Capital and Projects to Financials so labor and asset costs land in the plan without manual adjustments.

• Write Groovy rules and calc scripts where the standard module logic falls short.

• Serve as the main client contact for CFOs, VPs of FP&A and HR leaders.

• Own delivery scope, schedule and budget, and follow R-Cubed's escalation process when risks come up.

• Mentor EPM consultants and senior consultants with technical guidance and performance feedback.

• Write proposals and estimates for Planning pursuits, and look for ways to expand scope on current accounts.

• Build reusable designs for Capital, Workforce and Projects that the practice can use on future engagements.

Qualifications

• 5+ years implementing Oracle EPM, including at least 2 years in a client-facing leadership or principal role.

• Hands-on configuration of Workforce, Capital and Projects in EPM Cloud Planning, with at least one implementation where all three were integrated.

• Working knowledge of Financials Planning and how it connects to the other modules.

• Experience with Groovy, calc scripts, Data Integration and EPM Automate.

• Understands HR cost drivers and fixed asset accounting well enough to challenge a client's requirements.

• Consulting or professional services background strongly preferred.

• Comfortable presenting to CFOs and other executives in plain business terms.

• Experience leading and developing consultants. People-management experience preferred.

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, information systems or a related field preferred. MBA is a plus.

• Experience with FCC, ARCS, EPCM or EDM is a plus.

• Oracle EPM Planning certification strongly preferred.

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive salary with a performance-based commission structure

• Medical, vision, and dental insurance for employees and eligible dependents

• 401(k) plan

• Paid time off

• Life and disability insurance

• A collaborative, employee-centered culture that values transparency, teamwork, and professional growth

R-Cubed is an equal opportunity
